name: עֲמֹרָה
summary: Gomorrah is a city named with Sodom, Admah and Zeboiim on the boundary of Canaanite territory; its king fled with the king of Sodom in the Valley of Siddim. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The boundary description lists עֲמֹרָה between Sodom and Admah.
The king of Gomorrah flees along with the king of Sodom in the Valley of Siddim.
Sodom and Gomorrah are named together as the cities whose property was taken.

note: Moved from the former word entry `3eamoraah`. The old root key עמרה recorded the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
